description: This file defines an interface for a wrapper around GLib functions, including a factory class for obtaining a singleton instance. It declares the IGlibWrapper interface with various methods for object property management, signal handling, memory allocation, and type information, as well as the IGlibWrapperFactory for creating or retrieving the singleton instance. The file is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace and includes external dependencies such as <gst/gst.h> and standard headers.
